Chapter 579: Chapter 20 Peak (Seeking Subscriptions)_2

Chapter 579: Chapter 20 Peak (Seeking Subscriptions)_2

“In my view, the Martial Tao Cultivation Skill is nothing special; although it can encompass the vast majority of bloodlines, it cannot compare to our Imperial Cultivation Skill when it comes to targeting specific bloodlines…”

Another young man couldn’t help but say.

The Longshan Family made their Martial Tao Cultivation Skill publicly available, and after spreading rapidly, it likewise reached the imperial family of the empire.

Fabian immediately realized the importance of the Martial Tao Cultivation Skill, which might lead to a revolution in all knights’ cultivation skills, and promptly brought his people to Longshan City to discreetly observe that Viscount Longshan.

“You should say, our Imperial Cultivation Skill cannot compare to the Martial Tao Cultivation Skill,” Fabian glanced at the young man and shook his head, “This Viscount Longshan has unlimited potential and could very likely step into the seventh rank.”

Once these words were spoken,

...

the others around him were immediately dumbfounded.

Had they ever heard Fabian give such high praise to a knight? Unlimited potential? Very likely to step into the seventh rank?

Good heavens.

Were these words really coming from the usually proud Fabian?

“You don’t believe it?”

Fabian’s tone remained calm as he continued to listen carefully to Lin Yuan’s lecture below.

He couldn’t see through Lin Yuan’s strength and didn’t detect anything out of the ordinary, but from every single word Lin Yuan uttered about the essence of power and the essence of cultivation, he faintly felt that Viscount Longshan’s future achievements would far exceed his own.

At least when Fabian was his age, he only knew how to exert power and had far less understanding of the essence of power than the current Viscount Longshan.

And the higher one’s cultivation, the more Fabian realized how important it was to understand the essence of power.

“My lord, it’s not that we don’t believe it, it’s just too unbelievable…”

The other few people glanced at each other and said carefully.

What a joke. Wasn’t every seventh rank demigod knight with a powerful and profound bloodline difficult to reach? The ‘Mountain Dragon’ bloodline of the Longshan Family was indeed extraordinary, but its limit was the fifth rank; achieving the status of a seventh rank demigod seemed as hard as ascending to heaven.

“It doesn’t matter.”

“If you don’t believe it, just wait and see in five hundred years,” Fabian said indifferently, for he wouldn’t have dared make such a claim if he wasn’t certain that Viscount Longshan would step into the sixth rank within five hundred years.

For only sixth rank legendary knights could live more than five hundred years.

“The Martial Tao Cultivation Skill will be immediately popularized within our imperial family; otherwise, if we continue to wait, the surrounding empires will catch up.”

After pondering for a moment, Fabian spoke.

Over the years, there had been ongoing disputes within the imperial family about how to deal with the Martial Tao Cultivation Skill. At this moment, after having personally seen Viscount Longshan, Fabian had reached his conclusion.

As for blocking the news and keeping the Martial Tao Cultivation Skill solely within the imperial family? That was not very realistic. By now, too many knights within the empire were aware of the Martial Tao Cultivation Skill, and the same was true for the surrounding empires.

The reason there had been no movement so far was entirely because they were still studying the Martial Tao Cultivation Skill.

“Understood.”

The knights behind him immediately responded.

In the imperial family, Fabian’s authority was second only to the Rank Church, and within the family itself, his word was absolute.

“Also, cozy up to this Viscount Longshan immediately, elevate his title to Earl, and the surrounding surplus territories, as well as the territories of those few viscounts, let them all go to the Longshan Family,” Fabian mused, then continued.

“Yes,”

the others glanced at one another and responded at once.

They clearly heard the unprecedented attention Fabian had for Viscount Longshan, directly elevating Viscount Longshan to Earl Longshan? Since the founding of the empire, there had never been such a significant elevation in noble rank, had there?

Moreover, Viscount Longshan hadn’t yet made any notable contributions.

After all, every earl in the empire could have their title and the right to their territory passed down forever, even higher than the empire itself.

“Let’s go.”

“It’s time to head back.”

Fabian took one last look at Longshan City below, then led his people back to the capital of the empire.

What the sixth rank peak legendary knight, Fabian, did not know was that just after he left, Viscount Longshan below cast a discreet glance at the spot where he had just been standing.

“He knows what’s up,” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Fabian and his group naturally couldn’t get past Lin Yuan’s perception.

Lin Yuan didn’t just perceive them; he heard every single word they said.

Lin Yuan had long anticipated that the spread of the Martial Tao Cultivation Skill would attract the attention of the empire.

After all, compared to the many knights’ cultivation skills, the Martial Tao Cultivation Skill was too special, fully capable of replacing the vast majority of knights’ cultivation skills.

Initially, Lin Yuan thought the empire might take some measures, like controlling him, the source of the Martial Tao Cultivation Skill?

But clearly, the higher-ups of the empire were not short-sighted. Realizing that there was no way to suppress the Martial Tao Cultivation Skill, they immediately took the initiative to join in.

They even started to woo and reward Lin Yuan, the person from whom the Martial Tao Cultivation Skill originated.

After a series of events, even Lin Yuan did not harbor any ill feelings towards the imperial family of the empire.

“My two Primordial Spirits have already begun to infiltrate the church…” Lin Yuan glanced into the distance.

Although called the ‘Plateau of Myriad Nations’, the number of empires present far exceeds ten thousand.

Lin Yuan had his two Primordial Spirits collect ‘divine crystals’ from churches of distant empires, naturally.

Rabbits don’t eat the grass at their burrow’s edge; the empire Lin Yuan was in was named the ‘Slan’ Empire, a place of faith for the Main God of Rank.

When dealing with a being at the level of a Prime God, Lin Yuan remained cautious enough not to provoke a Prime God lightly.

…

In another empire far, far away from the ‘Slan’ Empire.

This place is the land of faith for the ‘Stargaze’ True God, and the ‘Stargaze’ Church is the most exalted place in this empire.

Stargaze Church.

A large number of believers were worshipping devoutly, wisps of ephemeral faith energy converging on the statue of Stargaze True God, then transferred to the True God’s true form in the Ocean of Light through the statue.

In the depths of the church.

The Pope watched with a smiling face as divine crystals kept condensing in front of him.

“It seems my god is very pleased this time, to bestow so many divine crystals?” the Pope thought with joy.

Divine crystals contained incredibly pure energy, which could not only support divine incarnations but also greatly aid in cultivation.

The divine crystals bestowed by the Stargaze True God this time could sustain the cultivation of all the church’s fifth-level and above powerhouses for hundreds of years.

“If I could consume these divine crystals, perhaps I could step into the seventh rank, then raise the Divine Kingdom, and enter the Ocean of Light with my god, to exist eternally?”

The Pope stared at the divine crystals in front of him, and a hint of greed suddenly rose in his heart.

Just then.

A figure silently appeared beside the Pope.

The figure was indistinct in appearance, shrouded in a mysterious aura.

“Hmm?”

The Pope glanced at it, failed to react immediately, and then his face changed dramatically, “You are…..”

Before the Pope could finish his sentence, his consciousness plunged into darkness. When he awoke again, he found the divine crystals that the church had accumulated for thousands of years were gone.

“Who on earth?!!”

The Pope of the Stargaze Church had bloodshot eyes; so many divine crystals just vanished?

Outside the church.

Lin Yuan’s form reconstituted itself.

“Not bad.” Lin Yuan glanced at the newly acquired quantity of divine crystals and nodded slightly.

Though the quantity was not large, there were many such occasions; along the way, divine crystals amassed by dozens of churches had fallen into his hands.

“Keep going.”

Lin Yuan knew he had to be quick.

He aimed to gather enough divine crystals to step into the ninth rank before the gods could react.

…

Time passed.

Ten years flew by in a blink.

In these ten years, Lin Yuan’s two Primordial Spirits traveled through half of the Plateau of Myriad Nations, and countless churches of the True Gods fell prey to Lin Yuan’s pillage.

Of course, Lin Yuan was only interested in divine crystals. As for the congregations? He did not lay a hand on them.

He mainly wanted to minimize the situation as much as possible; killing the followers or only the church’s upper echelons would be tantamount to declaring war against the gods upfront, which would not benefit Lin Yuan’s subsequent collection of divine crystals.

…

Longshan Ling.

In an underground cave somewhere.

Lin Yuan looked at the large pile of divine crystals in front of him.

He took a gentle breath, and a great number of divine crystals shattered, merging into Lin Yuan’s body. In an instant, the Inner World within him began to expand, and the Spatial Layers became denser and more vast.

Having the experience of stepping into the ninth rank in the Main World Prime Universe.

Lin Yuan re-entered the ninth rank without any hiccups, even managing to suppress any noise from the breakthrough.

Whoooosh~

Inhale~~~

An indescribable and transient aura filled the air.

No one knew that in the insignificant location of Longshan Ling in the Slan Empire, an existence on par with the Twenty-Four Supreme Gods was born.
